title: KestrelCare Plan Credit Against Exchange Replacement Shipping on Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Credit term.** Under Vehicle Purchase Agreements, a KestrelCare service contract sold with the replacement vehicle of an exchange earns a protection plan credit against the exchange replacement shipping fee. The plan is read from the KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts record of the replacement order: its coverage level and whether it was sold with the vehicle.

| KestrelCare plan sold with the replacement vehicle | Protection plan credit |
|---|---|
| KestrelCare Platinum or KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | $150.00 (the top-plan credit) |
| KestrelCare Silver or KestrelCare Gold | $75.00 (the mid-plan credit) |
| any other plan (KestrelCare Powertrain, KestrelCare Powertrain Plus) | none |
| no plan sold with the vehicle | none |

**Where the credit applies.** The credit is subtracted from the exchange replacement shipping fee once the transport price has been reduced by the discount and rounded, together with anything added to that discounted fee, and the result is never below zero.

**Hypothetical cases.**
- Discounted fee $799.00, KestrelCare Gold sold with the replacement: the fee becomes $724.00.
- Discounted fee $1099.00, KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary: $949.00.
- Discounted fee $120.00, KestrelCare Platinum: $120.00 less $150.00 would go below zero, so the fee is $0.00.
- A KestrelCare Gold plan bought for a different vehicle, or no plan at all: no credit.
